title: ID0418388-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170001007] ENGIE EME-Issue with HMI-C1
description:
Reported issue: My colleague was on site on 09/04/2025 and test the payment terminal When selecting the "Pay by terminal" option from the HMI, the charger displays “Please wait” with the usual loading animation (spinning circle). However, it doesn’t proceed further after a few moments, it returns to the home screen, and the terminal remains unresponsive. The only temporary solution so far has been to reboot the charger. What’s concerning is that there are no error flags indicating that the terminal is disconnected. We only become aware of the issue when someone is on-site and confirms that the terminal is not functioning. As I have highlighted in other tickets, this issue appears to be affecting multiple SI charge D chargers equipped with CCV terminals, and seems to be spreading. For that reason, I woud really appreciate it if this issue could be treated as high priority.
Solution:
yyyy-mm-dd:
R&D Ticket: EVC3-9297 and EMOB-18177
